thread:
kevin: Heads up — after rolling kernel-selector change (v2) to Qwen-6B we see ~4.2% drop in CODEGEN eval top-1. P95 latency improved though. Rolling back? cc @maria @aj :thinking:
perf-bot: Perf quick summary: https://perf.redwood.company/runs/2101112219 (p95 -12ms, top1 -4.2%) :chart_with_downwards_trend:
maria: Can we confirm if this is from the kernel swap (tiled->tiled_v2) or the RoPE-scale tweak? My PR touched both selection heuristic + a tiny rope bias fix.
aj: I only changed the selector heuristic (prefer tiled_v2 when seq_len>512). I did flip quant-toggle on a subset of hosts but only for mixtral workloads, not Qwen.
kevin: Stack traces point at the attention path. Saw kernel id switch at ~40 tokens in the trace. Pasting trimmed logs:
```
[2026-03-10T15:12:01Z] kernel_selector: chosen=tiled_v2, fallback=tiled
[2026-03-10T15:12:01Z] attn_impl: kernel=matmul_tiled_v2, rope_scale=0.995, kv_layout=packed
[2026-03-10T15:12:02Z] output_diff: eval_id=codegen-2026-03, sample=342, token_idx=57, logit_delta=0.18
```
sophia: I ran the 1k eval locally toggling tiled_v2 off — metrics return to baseline. So far looks like kernel swap. :mag:
aj: Bisect over the selector change shows MSE spike correlates with choosing tiled_v2 for heads 12-24. Could be an indexing/stride assumption in the new tiled kernel interacting with qwen's head packing.
maria: Hmm — qwen has nonstandard head dim packing (64->split 2x32 in optimized impl). If tiled_v2 assumed contiguous head layout, that'd explain bit flips in attention accumulation.
kevin: Good catch. Also noticed minor rope_scale tweak in my PR (0.995->0.99) for longcontext smoothing — but local ablation didn't reproduce significant drop alone.
sophia: Plan: disable tiled_v2 in canary, keep rope tweak disabled, run 1k eval and 10k samples for codegen. If passes, revert selector change and schedule kernel-v2 patch.
devops: Pushed canary rollback flag to zone-us-west-2 (selector.force=tiled). New run kicked: https://perf.redwood.company/runs/2101112266 :rocket:
perf-bot: Canary run started (id=2101112266). Baseline comparison queued.
triage-bot: Created ticket RF-4721 for kernel-selector regression, assigned to eng-runtime.
aj: I'll open a minimal repro with tiny model snapshot + input that triggers head split to share with kernel authors.
maria: We should also add a quick assertion in kernel-selector to check head-packing compatibility before choosing tiled_v2. Prevent future silent quality regressions.
kevin: Agreed. If canary passes we'll roll out revert and keep tiled_v2 behind a gated flag until kernel authors validate packing. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
